postgres.description: Integer overflow in array subscripting permits a crafted stacked statement to read out-of-bounds relations, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to read arbitrary relations.
Unprivileged user may execute arbitrary SQL as superuser during index expression evaluation. Does not permit remote unauthenticated read.
